summary: Classover Holdings, Inc. (now KIDZ AI Inc.) filed an 8-K reporting a First Amendment to its Securities Purchase Agreement for up to $500M in senior secured convertible notes. The amendment modifies the use of proceeds from Additional Closings, requiring deposits into a Control Account until the Available Cash Test is met, then permitting working capital or AI-related capex. No new securities were issued, no tender, merger, or special situation event occurred. This is a routine financing amendment.
